text:
alex: quick follow-up from the postmortem — want to lock owners and ETAs for alert noise reduction? small sync here.
marie: thanks. started a doc with proposed rule changes. goals: reduce noise, add fingerprinting + dedupe, implement sensible paging windows.
jonah: +1. prefer rate-limited paging and escalation windows over full silences so infra still gets aware.
taylor: rough action list i think we need: 1) fingerprint by cluster+service+error_type (owner @jonah, ETA 2d). 2) add 15m dedupe window for flapping alerts (owner @marie, ETA EOW). 3) map throttles to non-paging severity unless business-impacting (owner @alex, ETA next week).
alex: :white_check_mark: i'll take #3. also we should apply to Dedicated pools and private deploys as a follow-through.
marie: sample rule snippet i put in the doc:
```expr: increase(service_errors_total[5m]) / increase(requests_total[5m]) > 0.05 unless on_maintenance == 1 for 10m
labels:
  alert: ServiceErrorNoise
  severity: page
fingerprint: "{{cluster}}-{{service}}-{{error_type}}"
```
jonah: LGTM. for paging windows: can we only page oncall_primary 08:00-20:00 PT, and route to oncall_secondary outside those hours? reduces night wakeups.
taylor: agree. add nightly suppression for low-traffic regions (owner @taylor, ETA 3d). also doc paging policy changes in runbook.
marie: added tasks and links in the postmortem doc: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/2026-03-22-alert-spike
alex: need a measurement dashboard too. key metrics: page count by rule, % pages with no-action, MTTA, MTTR. owner @jonah?
jonah: i'll wire grafana panels and a short dashboard. ETA 4 business days.
taylor: propose a 30-day review to ensure tuning didn't hide real incidents. schedule a check on Apr 6. @marie can you own scheduling?
marie: scheduled Apr 6 10:00am PT, invite sent to eng-oncall + SRE.
alex: summary of owners: jonah -> fingerprint + dashboard; marie -> dedupe rules + schedule; taylor -> suppression + policy doc; alex -> severity mapping + Dedicated coverage. i'll track in weekly oncall sync. :thumbsup:
sre-bot: reminder: please create Jira tickets for each action and tag with label "pm-alert-tuning".
jonah: created JIRA RINF-3281 (fingerprint + dashboard), RINF-3282 (dedupe rule), RINF-3283 (paging windows & suppression). linked them in the doc.
alex: perfect. closing thread for now — update tickets if blockers pop up and ping here if we need additional approvals.
